sessionName: Week 4 - Sales execution from DD to 100-day plan
summary: George Berrington reviewed DD engagement letters and 100-day plan proposals with Simon Clarke and Priya Natarajan. DD is sold quickly on fee and turnaround, and the 100-day plan is only raised after completion, often too late. We agreed to bundle a 100-day plan option into every DD engagement letter.

discussion.keyPoints: Priya said DD is decided within 48 hours, usually on fee and availability. There is little room for discovery.
Simon said the 100-day plan conversation usually happens after completion, by which time the operating partner may have appointed someone else.
Deal teams regularly push for a 15 to 20% discount on DD. Priya felt Harcourt concedes too easily.

recommendations.recommendation: Include a priced 100-day plan option in every DD engagement letter, at a fixed 45,000 GBP for a standard portfolio company.
Cap DD discounts at 10% and only in exchange for the 100-day plan option being accepted.
Brief the operating partner at the DD readout, not just the deal team, to set up the 100-day plan.
Train the 6 DD leads to present the 100-day plan option at the readout.
Decline DD on deals below 30m GBP enterprise value.

actions.action: Update the DD engagement letter template with the 100-day plan option
Run a readout role-play with the DD leads

nextFocus: Define pipeline stages that track DD and 100-day plan opportunities separately.
nextPreparation: Simon to export current pipeline from the practice management system.

tests.question: What did we agree to include in every DD engagement letter?
Is the DD discount cap agreed?
Who did we agree to train to present the 100-day plan?
